title: Route 231 (Blue Ridge Turnpike and F.T. Valley Road)
direction: Follows the mapped byway from Sperryville to Madison.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic

moments.title: Madison
moments.text: A county seat of 205 people in 2020, where Route 231 shares Main Street with the old line of US 29 before heading north on Blue Ridge Turnpike.

moments.title: Old Rag Mountain
moments.text: Unlike most of the Blue Ridge it has a bare rocky summit of granite about a billion years old, and the most common way up starts at Nethers, off Route 231.

moments.title: Sperryville
moments.text: Francis Thornton Jr. began selling lots for his little town in 1820, and by 1880 it had a woolen mill, seven distillers, four general stores and one saloon.

stretches.title: Sperryville to Madison
stretches.line: The byway between Sperryville and Madison.
